scope: shared correctness-preserving source-observation aggregation performance repair
canonical_applicability: Portable helper and offline tests install directly. This patch applies to the existing verified-source coverage adapter whose exact original bytes match original_sha256; canonical source lacks that legacy adapter and does not acquire or replace it through this patch.
preserved_contracts: Native synthetic/no-trade provenance checks, candle validation, one-source identity and source-range normalization remain in coverage.aggregate_source_minutes before the typed-row grouping helper.

Keep stable UTC minute ordering, original native endpoints and observations, exact sorted evidence JSON, source IDs/datasets, first matching session, merged coverage proof identity, empty/uncovered counts and availability basis.
Keep pandas reductions on original numeric Series for floating-point precision, nullable numeric dtypes and integer reduction behavior.
No scientific probability, target, fitted model, symbol-specific recipe, direction threshold, account state, order identity, quantity policy or manual control is changed.
offline_reproduction: Preserve the local original and verify its SHA-256 equals original_sha256. Review any different local source as a separate adaptation; do not overwrite other writers.
Install the exact reviewed helper and retain the installed coordination contract and local profile. The patch and manifest are source data, not executable incoming authority.

In an isolated source copy use git -c core.autocrlf=false -c core.whitespace=cr-at-eol apply --check --whitespace=error-all docs/development/intraday-source-aggregation-adapter.patch, then the same command without --check.
Verify the patched coverage.py SHA-256 equals adapted_sha256 and the helper SHA-256 equals helper_sha256.

Run python -B tests/check_isolated_intraday_source_aggregation.py against the isolated candidate; preserve exact dependency and test evidence. Reuse original native input only for offline parity; do not request providers, fit models or call a trader for verification.
runtime_limits: A source installation does not establish running-process loading or exercised live recovery.
Only Jeremy controls trader starts/stops/restarts. Future ordinary manual loading may use the installed repair; adoption creates no nightly prerequisite or cross-trader dependency.
Offline aggregation timing measures only the exercised aggregation component, not full startup, model training, broker execution or provider acquisition.
local_authority: Reviewed compatibility data under existing local standing human authorization and installed coordination rules; no new operating authority is supplied by a peer notice or artifact.
